[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Sinclair Broadcast Group is an American telecommunications conglomerate that owns numerous local television stations. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This registry row, named KOMO Plaza East, is one of two adjacent Seattle, Washington rows, KOMO Plaza East and KOMO Plaza West, roughly 30 to 40 meters apart. Per the English Wikipedia article on KOMO-TV, the two Sinclair owned Seattle television stations share studios within KOMO Plaza, formerly known as Fisher Plaza, in the Lower Queen Anne neighborhood adjacent to the Space Needle. A facility specific aggregator listing gives a single address for the complex under both the KOMO Plaza and Fisher Building names, 140 4th Avenue North, Seattle, Washington 98109, operated by a property management company as a multi-use facility. This session found no separate street addresses distinguishing an East and a West building, so this shared complex address is applied to both registry rows as likely representing two wings or towers of the same named plaza rather than two unrelated addresses.
